welcome to katugotchi

hi, i'm katu, i like tamagotchis and intermittently capitalizing the letter I. This website exists because I crave the olden days of my childhood, and also I want to share my love of tamagotchi with the internet. I will have a little, likely neglected blog, as well as links to resources and a little art gallery - eventually.

I'm also designing a virtual pet game, WhimsyKins, which I hope to release on Android before 2077.
